method: Own pure Python algorithms; no frozen collector/saved-reader algorithms imported. All pilots/warmups/timed raw JSON finite+canonical/admission, exact commands, GNU clocks, process records, order and statistics recomputed. Only the single completed attempt used; no partial observations pooled or samples omitted.
limitations: Exit/watchdog and source/blob/binary/lock guard values checked as recorded; source/native module bytes and CLI not rerun.
Parent monotonic/wait4 clocks cannot be independently remeasured; raw GNU time floats checked against each measurement.
Resource gates bound pre-child admission, not continuous load/memory isolation; machine scheduling and output filesystem I/O remain in fresh-process wall times.
Waited maxRSS includes wrapper/descendants and inherited memory high-water behavior; GNU child maxRSS recorded separately, no allocator attribution claim.
Observed ratios describe these four workloads/eight samples per variant on this host; no confidence interval or significance/general speed claim implied.
Independent primary chemical calibration, full CI/fleet and guarded merge are separate requirements.
